valid_credit.name: valid_credit
valid_credit.value: "contributions"."amount_cents" >= 0 AND "contributions"."tax_cents" >= 0 AND "contributions"."fee_cents" >= 0 AND "contributions"."margin_cents" >= 0 AND "contributions"."credit_cents" >= 0 AND "contributions"."reserved_cents" >= 0 AND "contributions"."debited_cents" >= 0 AND "contributions"."reserved_cents" + "contributions"."debited_cents" <= "contributions"."credit_cents"

outcome_evidence.name: outcome_evidence
outcome_evidence.value: ("results"."outcome" = 'pull_request' AND "results"."pull_request_url" IS NOT NULL AND "results"."abstention_reason" IS NULL) OR ("results"."outcome" = 'abstained' AND "results"."abstention_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "results"."pull_request_url" IS NULL)
